name: Personio
description_en:
Personio is an HR platform with Core and Core Pro plans plus separately selectable apps. Its official help center documents employee records, time management, workflows and analytics, while differentiating those base-plan functions from recruiting, payroll and other apps.

The public marketing origin returned 429 and was not retried. This profile instead uses readable Personio help-center articles on support.personio.de, whose footer names Personio SE & Co. KG and links to the main Personio site. Published plan definitions support documentation research, but current numeric pricing and actual account entitlements remain unverified.
description_zh:
Personio 是 HR 平台，提供 Core、Core Pro 方案及可另选的应用。官方帮助中心说明员工档案、时间管理、工作流及分析，并区分基础方案功能与招聘、工资等应用。

营销官网返回 429 后未重试。本稿改用正常可读的 support.personio.de 官方帮助文章，页脚署名 Personio SE & Co. KG 并链接主站。公开方案定义可支持文档研究，但当前数值报价及具体账户权益仍未核实。

core_features.name_zh: 员工档案与 HR 流程
core_features.explanation_en: Core documents employee files, time tracking, time off and onboarding/offboarding workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: Core 文档列出员工档案、工时、休假及入离职流程。

core_features.name_zh: 按方案区分的权限与应用
core_features.explanation_en: Core Pro adds capabilities such as public API access and additional identity integrations; recruiting and payroll appear as apps.
core_features.explanation_zh: Core Pro 增加公共 API 访问及其他身份集成等功能，招聘与工资列为应用。

core_features.explanation_en: Analytics separates summary metrics from reports and requires the documented role or configuration rights.
core_features.explanation_zh: Analytics 区分指标概览与报表，并要求文档列出的角色或配置权限。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Plan boundaries matter before feature comparison
sections.title_zh: 比较功能前先核对方案边界
sections.en: The September 2026 plan article lists one legal entity and 5 MB of documents per employee across custom categories in Core. Core Pro lists unlimited legal entities and document management, public API access, OAuth and Okta/Microsoft Entra ID integrations. Core e-signature workflows are limited to 8% of subscribed employee licenses in the documented example; Core Pro lists unlimited workflows, but qualified electronic signatures are a separately billed per-signature add-on. Confirm the contract rather than treating every named capability as universal.
sections.zh: 2026 年 9 月方案文章列出 Core 包含一个法律实体，自定义类别的文件总量为每员工 5 MB；Core Pro 列出无限法律实体及文件管理、公共 API、OAuth、Okta/Microsoft Entra ID 集成。文档将 Core 电子签名额度列为订阅员工许可数的 8%；Core Pro 工作流列为不限量，但合格电子签名仍是逐次收费的附加服务。应核对合同，不能把所有列出的能力视为普遍权益。

sections.title_en: Evaluate records, reporting and paid apps separately
sections.title_zh: 分别评估档案、报表与付费应用
sections.en: A practical documentation-based pilot would define an employee record, a time-off approval and an onboarding workflow, then verify the relevant roles and selected plan in a real trial. Recruiting Small/Medium/Large are documented for 5, 25 or unlimited jobs. Preliminary payroll in Core is not equivalent to purchasing Personio Payroll, and the app list does not establish payroll availability or statutory compliance in every country.
sections.zh: 按文档可设计员工档案、休假审批和入职流程试点，再在真实试用中检查角色及方案。招聘 Small/Medium/Large 文档分别列出 5、25 或不限职位。Core 的预备工资数据处理不等同于购买 Personio Payroll，应用列表也不能证明所有国家均可使用工资服务或满足当地法定义务。

sections.title_en: Read permissions before generating HR reports
sections.title_zh: 生成 HR 报表前检查权限
sections.en: Analytics is available with Core, but viewing the area requires Administrator status or edit rights to Configuration > Reports. Metrics displays widgets based on the Report Builder; Reports provides templates or custom report creation, and a legacy Classic Builder remains documented. An evaluator should test who can see sensitive attributes and shared reports. The article describes access prerequisites, not an independent privacy or authorization audit.
sections.zh: Analytics 随 Core 提供，但查看区域需管理员身份或 Configuration > Reports 编辑权限。Metrics 显示基于 Report Builder 的组件，Reports 支持模板或自建报表，文档亦保留旧 Classic Builder。评估者应测试敏感属性及共享报表的可见范围；文章说明的是访问条件，并非独立隐私或授权审计。

sections.title_en: Subscription changes and unknown numeric prices
sections.en: The October 22, 2026 article requires account subscription-management edit permission for self-service changes; disabled controls can also reflect plan restrictions. Added seats or upgrades take effect immediately with prorating. It describes downgrade eligibility for monthly customers or customers with fewer than 50 seats, a 25-seat minimum, and reductions at the next renewal. Personio Payroll or DATEV customers cannot add apps through that self-service flow. Detailed monetary quotes are not stated in the pages read, so pricing remains not verified.
sections.zh: 2026 年 10 月 22 日文章要求具备账户订阅管理编辑权限才能自助变更；控件不可用也可能来自方案限制。增加席位或升级立即生效并按比例计费。文档说明按月客户或少于 50 席位客户可符合降级条件，最低 25 席位，减少内容在下次续约生效；使用 Personio Payroll 或 DATEV 的客户不能按该流程自助添加应用。实读页面没有具体金额，价格保持未核实。

research_gaps.en: Numeric prices, contract-specific entitlements, payroll countries, processing terms and deployment/data-residency commitments remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 数值报价、具体合同权益、工资服务国家、数据处理条款及部署/驻留承诺未核实。

research_gaps.en: Employee imports, onboarding, permission isolation, exports, payroll and billing changes were not executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行员工导入、入职、权限隔离、导出、工资或账单变更。
